description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class 'AbstractTypedSubstitutionStrategy' for substitution strategies operating on specific subtypes of 'WithDittoHeaders'. It includes static utility methods for substituting subjects, policy entries, policies, ACL entries, ACLs, and 'Thing' objects, mainly used within policy and access control contexts. The class implements the 'SubstitutionStrategy' interface and provides mechanisms to match certain header subtypes for substitution operations.

classes.name: AbstractTypedSubstitutionStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class providing a generic implementation for substitution strategies based on specific 'WithDittoHeaders' subtypes. It includes utility methods for substituting subjects, policies, ACL entries, and 'Thing' objects, facilitating header-based policy management.

methods.name: AbstractTypedSubstitutionStrategy
methods.description: Constructor accepting a Class object representing the specific subtype of 'WithDittoHeaders' that this strategy will handle.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Determines if the provided 'WithDittoHeaders' instance matches the subtype handled by this strategy.

methods.name: substituteSubjects
methods.description: Replaces subject IDs in the given 'Subjects' collection based on a substitution algorithm and headers.

methods.name: substitutePolicyEntry
methods.description: Creates a new 'PolicyEntry' with subject IDs substituted, if changes are needed.

methods.name: substitutePolicy
methods.description: Generates a new 'Policy' with substituted entries based on the provided substitution algorithm and headers.

methods.name: substitutePolicyEntries
methods.description: Replaces entries within an iterable of 'PolicyEntry' objects, returning an iterable with substitutions applied where necessary.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces an element at a specific index within an iterable of 'PolicyEntry' objects.

methods.name: substituteAclEntry
methods.description: Creates a new 'AclEntry' with the subject ID substituted, if changed.

methods.name: substituteAcl
methods.description: Replaces entries within an 'AccessControlList' with substituted entries.

methods.name: substituteThing
methods.description: Creates a new 'Thing' object with an updated access control list if substitutions are necessary.
